constraints.statement: Printed Possessions give two missile launchers with four magazines, and a distinct light concussion launcher with two light concussion missiles. Neither magazine capacity nor replacement ammunition is inferred.

A separate equipment sidebar defines light concussion missile launcher as a heavy weapon with its own rate of fire and ammunition; vehicle/size-target attack penalty is not a generic -5 to all attacks.

Two printed tool appendages do not themselves certify three simultaneous physically installed or hand-held missile weapons. Printed alternative attacks remain source-only until mounts and grip are reviewed.
Published VX series artillery droids cannot be played as droid heroes.

source.citationLabel: Printed Possessions: astrogation buffer (storage device, 5 memory units)

constraints.statement: The stock possessed astrogation buffer has five memory units; narrative describes storing up to five hyperspace coordinate sets. Neither means unlimited routes or free starship navigation permissions.
Built-in storage is 2 kg, separate from the possessed buffer, saw, welder, electroshock probe, extinguisher, holoprojector and holorecorder.
The droid has wheeled 6 and walking 4 square speeds, with magnetic feet as another installed system. It does not thereby acquire flying movement.
Printed model can be played as a droid hero, but its nonheroic 3 level, chosen feats, and listed equipment are not universal free starting grants.

constraints.statement: Narrative says R5 can store only ONE set of hyperspace coordinates despite shared astromech appearance; no astrogation buffer is listed in Possessions. No extra buffer is invented.
Later Rebel user modifications expanded R5 astrogation to six, seven, or ten sets; those are owner modifications, not factory capabilities, and installation procedure is not specified.
Listed six tool appendages, one claw, telescopic appendage and separately possessed six tools/electronics are not permission for extra weapon attacks.
R5 can be used as a droid hero but does not gain owner-modified navigation memory as stock.

systems.sourceSystemsRaw: wheeled locomotion, walking locomotion, magnetic feet, heuristic processor, 4 tool appendage, claw appendage, telescopic appendage, diagnostics package, integrated comlink, internal storage (1 kg), improved sensor package, darkvision

constraints.statement: R7 narrative describes up to FIFTEEN hyperspace coordinate sets in active memory; no separate astrogation buffer is printed under Possessions. Avoid manufacturing an extra installed storage component.

R7 was designed for the E-wing and the printed narrative imposes -4 to ALL skill checks if installed in any other starfighter. This is a conditional ship-installation penalty, not universally -4 on foot.
Factory R7 has four tool appendages, one claw and one telescopic appendage; do not copy the R5's six-tool profile.
R7 may be played as a droid hero but the published nonheroic 6 and its class skill totals do not automatically become legal PC starting statistics.
